unit.why: A single anecdote: a villager's learned son-in-law visits the holy R. R"A, who repeatedly asks him 'what will God say' and then explains it as a rebuke of scholarly pride.

stories.start_quote: איש כפרי אחד שהי׳ דרכו לנסוע
stories.end_quote: לראותו נאו"ם ד׳ זה יאמר ד׳
stories.summary_en: A villager's scholarly son-in-law at first fears to visit the tzaddik R. R"A in case he is examined on Talmud. Once he feels confident in his learning he comes along, but the tzaddik ignores him and asks only 'what will God say' all Sabbath. On parting, the tzaddik explains with Jeremiah 23:24 that God cannot bear one who thinks himself learned and righteous.
